ValidationRule.description: A soft credit recognizes exactly one party: a contact or an account, never both and never neither (canonical model R-SC1).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISBLANK(Contact__c), ISBLANK(Account__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Account__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose one person or one organization to recognize, not both and not neither.
